assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One seamless repeatable OPAQUE SQUARE material texture for Depths, a dark first-person pixel cave crawler. Reference image is MATERIAL/PALETTE/PIXEL-STYLE reference only: the matching existing wall tile. Create a NEW surface for the specified role, perfectly flat orthographic material view, no perspective, no room scene. Fill every edge, no border or padding. Match the wall's hue, restrained value range, broad crisp clustered pixels and restrained 3-shade surfaces; intended native128x128/32-colour export. Large readable material shapes, sparse details, no photographic grain, painterly blur or hairline cracks. Diffuse albedo only, absolutely no directional light, ambient-occlusion vignette, cast shadows, glow or bright centre. Edges should tile in both axes with continuing material features and no conspicuous central motif. No loose props, bones, roots, pools, treasure, writing, emblems, floor traps, holes, stairs, doors or creatures. Role: WALKABLE MINE FLOOR seen straight down. Low uneven shale plates worn flat by passage, broad irregular fractures with fine compacted gritty earth only in shallow joints. Warm charcoal-grey and muted taupe like the reference, a little dull clay on plate edges. The surface reads as firm ground, not a pile of big rocks, wall masonry or dangerous gaps. Loose grit must be texture, not discrete pickup objects.
